name: User scripts and the Manifest V2 phase out
plain: Some extensions run your own scripts on pages, and Chrome no longer runs the old extension format.
meaning: chrome.userScripts runs user code on pages; its MAIN world is visible to the page and to other extensions. Chrome 139 removed Manifest V2 extensions, which changes what blockers can do. Userscript managers like Tampermonkey sometimes leave detectable traces.

web.api: chrome.userScripts.register({ id, matches, js, world }); GM_info; Manifest V2 background pages

access.prompt_ui: You turn the extension on and allow the userScripts permission

chrome.note: Needs the userScripts permission, host permissions and a user toggle

firefox.note: Partial, and Manifest V2 is still supported

data.metric: Some extensions run your own scripts on pages, and Chrome no longer runs the old extension format.

limits.headline: Can run your own code on pages through an extension, with a visible side effect in the MAIN world
limits.user_action: None, the page reads it silently
can: Run user supplied scripts on matched pages
Be seen by the page when it runs in the MAIN world
cannot: Run without you installing and allowing the extension
Work in Safari or on phones
limits.differs: Chrome 139 removed Manifest V2. Firefox still supports it. The Tampermonkey GM_info leak is low confidence.

story.what_it_is: Extensions can run your own small programs on websites, which changes what a page can see.

marketing.name: chrome.userScripts
marketing.pitch: Lets an extension run user supplied scripts on pages.

story.for_you: If you use a userscript manager, your own code can reshape sites. A site may notice those scripts.
story.for_makers: Extension authors need MV3 equivalents for old blocking behavior.

use_cases.example: A user script adds a missing button to a web app.

risks: Scripts can read pages you allow
MAIN world code is visible to the page

technical_bounds: Tampermonkey GM_info leak is low confidence
Userscript managers are Chromium and Firefox centered

history.change: Manifest V2 extensions no longer run
